status.decision: retain X1(33) only as a bounded future prototype candidate; production remains X1(27)

primary_formula.sampling_orientation: sample x deterministically and find sorted roots of the degree-10 polynomial in y

divisor_derivation.cyclic_proof: The sum of exact-order-33 and exact-order-4 points has exact order 132 because the orders are coprime.
divisor_derivation.group_proof: The odd order-33 subgroup intersects the audited selected-side 2-primary subgroup of order 16 trivially, so their product has order 528.

p125_trace_prior.rule: Use +(p+1) mod 528 when the published curve is the canonical Weber side and -(p+1) mod 528 when it is the canonical twist.

soundness_obligations: Evaluate the pinned plane equation and published q,t map directly over the target field and reject every zero denominator.
Validate the general Weierstrass equation and distinguished point, convert to the canonical short model exactly, and check [33]P=O, [11]P!=O, and [3]P!=O.
Reject singular curves, j=0, j=1728, absent or ramified Weber lifts, and every explicit Montgomery identity mismatch.
Directly establish three distinct rational 2-torsion roots and the point-four condition before claiming any 2-primary divisor.
Identify the canonical curve/twist side by exact same-j scaling identities before assigning the sign of the trace prior.
Differentially verify the omitted ell=11 trace residue with independent Schoof or brute-force small-field counts.
Bind the family schema, formula digest, sampling/root-order domains, point-four flag, exact-order policy, trace-prior policy and group-divisor policy into the schedule digest.
Begin with a hard max_x_samples diagnostic probe; do not add an unbounded production generator before the bounded gates pass.

quantitative_screen.interpretation: The model permits only a 1.5421% wall-time penalty at break-even. Reusing the prior 5% promotion margin requires X1(33) to be about 3.29% faster in wall time despite its larger generator.

balance_evidence.credible_mechanism: The exact prior grows from modulus 432 to 528, lowers initial Hasse-lattice density by 18.18%, and makes the scheduled prime ell=11 redundant.
balance_evidence.generator_risk: The root polynomial grows from degree 6 to degree 10 and coefficient degree from 8 to 20 relative to X1(27); admission density is unknown.
balance_evidence.retained_x1_11_prior_evidence: A historical X1(11) before/after prior window removed all ten ell=11 evaluations and 16 total SEA levels, but changed binaries and introduced a prior from scratch, so its 1.08222x wall result is not transferable.
balance_evidence.retained_ell_11_cost_boundary: The checked AWS single-thread p125 ell=11 record spent 0.209100 seconds in modular roots; skipping ell=11 alone is not a guaranteed large win.

bounded_future_gate.phase_1: Implement only a hard-bounded diagnostic generator in an isolated clone and test exact formulas, map denominators, exact order 33, canonical side, and sharp 132/264/528 divisors over small fields.
bounded_future_gate.phase_2: When cores are free, run a generator-only reverse-order p125 gate; close the route if generation work exceeds 2.0x X1(27) or has an unstable admission tail.
bounded_future_gate.phase_3: Only after phase 2 passes, add a schedule-bound experimental family and run same-binary reverse-order SEA windows with no heuristic outcomes and independent ell=11 projection checks.
bounded_future_gate.break_even_rule: Close unless two independent windows exceed 1.0x conservative modeled opportunities per wall time.
bounded_future_gate.promotion_rule: Retain the 1.05x planning-rate margin, corresponding to at most 191.663 seconds on the current ten-curve reference window.

limitations: No X1(33) curve was generated at p125 and no X1(33) SEA timing exists.
The opportunity figures are Dickman--Mertens planning marginals, not observed certificate rates.
Curve-family trace bias, curve/twist correlation, group-exponent restrictions, representability, exact-order assembly and canonical verification are not modeled.
The 198.19-second reference comes from the retained clean X1(27) runs in the X1(25) negative family gate.
